digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion gates (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability)
propositions: Four criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) produced zero findings across ~7,900 agentic runs due to missing or inadequate applicability vocabulary in their triggers
A deterministic pre-filter gate must skip criteria only when the criterion's subject vocabulary is entirely absent from the plan, preserving LLM routing authority for fired plans
Pre-filtered criteria must be recorded in coverage.routing.det_gated with the rule name, and fired plans must route unchanged through the existing LLM router

T13 and T14 overlay criteria extend the _DET_OVERLAY_RULES table; removal-rationale and asserted-capability leaf criteria require a parallel _DET_LEAF_GATE_RULES table with a second gate block in orchestrator.route_criteria

Gate rules use conjunction (all text_all regexes must match), file_impact glob patterns, and file_impact reason regex for removal detection; asserted-capability requires both module-ref and capability-verb text legs to fire
Migrated T5a/T5d/T7/T12 rules must fire identically to current regex strings on representative texts to preserve backward compatibility
